_comment: Operator-maintained closure records for the JDK-only blocker artifacts.
Nothing in a runtime dump can say 'this was reviewed and closed' -- closure
is a human judgement, so it is recorded here and joined onto the
An entry is CLOSED only when it is one of:
bridge          implemented as a reviewed NativeKind::Bridge
intrinsic       implemented as a reviewed NativeKind::Intrinsic
real-bytecode   executed from real class bytes; the substitution is gone
generated-class implemented as legitimate generated class bytes
out-of-scope    explicitly declared out of scope, and the VM raises a
Anything else is 'open'. There is no 'wontfix' and no 'deferred'.
An off-vocabulary status is a hard error, not a warning.
'note' is mandatory in review even though the tool does not enforce it:
a status with no reviewer-supplied justification is not a closure.
See docs/jdk-only-native-review.md for the promotion checklist.
Rows that match nothing in a run are reported as stale. That is NOT proof
the blocker is gone -- the run may simply not have exercised it.
